s.note: the high-stakes game at the casino
s.how: Wrap 6 halved figs in 100g prosciutto. Warm 200g olives with orange peel and a pinch of fennel seeds. Break 150g aged cheddar into shards. Put everything on toothpicks so no one gets greasy fingers on the cards.

s.note: the dinner on the train where they size each other up
s.how: Toast 60g hazelnuts at 170C for 8 minutes and chop. Shave a fennel bulb paper thin and segment 2 oranges. Toss with butter lettuce leaves and dress at the last second with Dijon, white wine vinegar and olive oil.

m.how: Marinate 1.2kg lamb shoulder chops overnight in 4 garlic cloves, rosemary, lemon and olive oil. Grill hot until charred and pink inside. Roast 3 red capsicums and slice. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a crushed garlic clove.

w.note: a rich dessert for a rich game
w.how: Melt 125g dark chocolate with 125g butter. Whisk 2 eggs and 2 yolks with 60g sugar until pale, combine and fold in 30g flour. Bake in 4 buttered, cocoa-dusted moulds at 220C for 9 minutes. Turn out so the centres run.

d.note: Bond invents it at the poker table
d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml gin, 20ml vodka and 10ml white vermouth hard with ice until very cold. Strain into a deep chilled coupe and add a long strip of lemon peel. Makes four.
